new_issues.text: Hosting support was stated as 0-11 for seeds 1-2 and 0-13 for seeds 3-4. Under the 12-team format a bye seed always hosts DS games 1-2, and seeds 3-4 always host Wild Card games 1-2, so the minimum is 2 for both groups. That lower bound matters for low strikes. Corrected to 2-11 / 2-13 / 0-10 in variants_and_edge_cases[3], stage s6 description and distribution, and the season_sim audit reason.

No bonus-time or clock interaction or nonlinearity remains. s5 matches.

mlb.draft_order_slot_assignment applied the ten-slot draft penalty to clubs 'over the highest surcharge threshold'. Under the 2022 CBA it applies at $40M or more over the base CBT threshold (third tier, not the $60M top tier); the club's highest pick moves back ten places unless it is a top-6 pick. A non-playoff club at slots 7-10 can be moved, and those are settling slots. Corrected the measurement and the s1 description.
